usefulness.rationale: Judge support findings named unknown claims or statements that are not verbatim excerpts of their named claims, or invalid citation selections. A reader learns who Freixe is (Nestlé CEO 2024–2025), why he was fired (undisclosed relationship with a subordinate, code-of-conduct violation, no severance), his successor, and the ongoing 2026 legal dispute. However, the dossier contains an unflagged internal conflict (39 years at Nestlé per foodnavigator vs 40 years per Daily Beast), gives little else about his career history (e.g., prior roles, EDHEC anchor is not supported by any retained citation), and the year "September last year" (2025) requires inference. It does flag contested claims and uses hedged attribution ("reportedly", "a source close to him"), which is good, but it does not explicitly note the 39-vs-40-year discrepancy or the thin biographical coverage. Adequate for preparing a meeting, though a reader would want clarity on which tenure figure is right and on the status of settlement talks versus litigation.
